exact_missing_items: Provider/model/effort settings must be available at these levels: run/global, feature seam, work package, node, work package overseer, feature seam overseer, overseer-delegated node worker
Provider/model controls must support these configuration levels: package, seam, node, overseer, and delegated-subagent — per-thread/per-run granularity alone is insufficient
Plans/Models_System.md model selection must become lane-aware — models must be selectable/overridable per lane context

treat as three separate axes: source axis (where configured value came from), request axis (what the run/attempt actually asked for at execution start), execution/result axis (what provider/runtime actually used and whether controls were honored/skipped/clamped)
Canonical display groups for settings: Inherited from, Overridden by, Requested, Effective, Reason, Support
Source layers needing explicit labeling: app default, project override, surface default, role policy, seam/package/node mapping, manual override, turn/session/run/task/subagent scoped override
UI should show the winning source, not force the user to reconstruct precedence from docs
honored/skipped/clamped is a third concept distinct from requested/effective difference
use explicit support chips or rows for runtime controls: Reasoning effort: High -> Skipped, Temperature: 0.2 -> Honored, Top-p: 1.0 -> Clamped to 0.9
if requested == effective and nothing was skipped/clamped, compact display is fine; if they differ, the UI must expand/disclose the difference visibly
gap_candidates.blocking_reason: Coverage row indicates incomplete or missing canon alignment for concrete target.
